svg.title: Schedule of materials, sheet A-102: 352 items across 14 disciplines, every tool from every repository and engagement. A wall section stacks one stratum per discipline, thick by how many items it holds. A tracer walks through six projects, AURIXA (92 materials), ReBo (83 materials), FlowState (72 materials), shelf (55 materials), DADM (52 materials), KeepMeAwake (50 materials), and lights every material each one uses. The full list is in text below.
